reasons: The selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but system.cpu.time is a monotonic sum and the dataset only has sum for it, so the selector matches nothing. It should be otel_metric_type="sum".

The promql applies a literal 100 to convert seconds-per-second to percent. The rules forbid numeric constants not in the Datadog source; the unit scale belongs in notes with a documentation link, not in promql.
The grouping label host_name is not in the observed dataset labels for system.cpu.time, so the by-clause cannot be verified and may select no series.
The unit differs: Datadog iowait is a percentage, while the candidate yields a ratio scaled by a constant it should not apply.
The aggregation (max over per-host avg of rate of cpu_mode="wait") and the dropped $scope variable are otherwise consistent with the Datadog request.
